purpose: Define a clean-room, evidence-controlled integration pattern for deterministic document ingestion and approval-stage review.

external_reference.name: GM-Copilot Studios / GM-Copilot-App
external_reference.relationship_status: public design reference only; no partnership, endorsement, access, code reuse, or affiliation is implied
external_reference.reuse_rule: Review licensing and obtain written permission before copying code, branding, prompts, data, or other protected material.

prohibited_shortcuts: No external claim from unreviewed or unproven input
No credential, personal data, exact site address, or private contact data in source control
No automatic grant, regulatory, safety, financial, or contract decision

approval_workflow.decision_rule: Gemini may produce a recommendation after Systems Administrator consultation. The Systems Administrator records the final decision and any conditions or exceptions.

credential_policy.credential_source: Manus managed Gemini connector or an approved secret manager
credential_policy.rotation_policy: Rotate any credential exposed in chat, logs, screenshots, commits, or client-side code before deployment.

publication_controls.translation_gate: Use a qualified translator or subject-matter reviewer for technical, legal, environmental, laboratory, carbon, financial, and commercialization content.
